claim_boundary: Action-level evidence consistency and concrete state-tracking failures; not proof of causal memory use, reflective revision, parenting causality, or pooled-learner improvement

definitions.extra_reads: Before first route, public memory already contains a full current-to-goal path; additional reads may check alternatives and are not automatically bad
definitions.failed_route: Original invalid_route rejection separated from committed route to terminal wrong destination
definitions.goal_path_supported_route: Previously returned EVENT edges contain a path from current node via chosen edge to public goal within remaining committed-route budget
definitions.known: Information present in public prefix, not a claim the model understood it
definitions.memory_evidence_consistent_route: Committed source/port/destination/receipt exactly match an EVENT actually returned before the action
definitions.revision: No causal/semantic revision label assigned; invalid actions end episodes before error feedback or retry
definitions.unique_reads: Sum of within-episode distinct accepted addresses; separate cohort-wide address count
